parameters: \n<Andres Bonifacio>Brothers. I have heard of your victories. My heart
\n<Andres Bonifacio>But I have also heard other things. That some are
arguing. That some are fighting not because of the
Spanish — but because of fellow Katipuneros.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>I am the Supremo of the Katipunan. Our rules say — the
Katipunan is the government. There is no other.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>We should not fight each other. We should unite against
a single enemy. The Spanish. Not each other.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>That is what I have to say. Let us talk. Let us plan.
